lessons.title: 1. Script Automation & File Processing
lessons.description: Automate text file filtering and line processing in Python.
lessons.solution_code:
def filter_log_lines(lines: list[str], keyword: str) -> list[str]:
    return [line for line in lines if keyword in line]

tests.name: test_filter_log_lines
